# ibee_gpu_vm (Resource)

A gpu VM. A plan_id change resizes the VM in place and an ssh_key_ids change updates its access in place; the API decides whether a change is allowed. Other configuration changes replace the VM. Imports use the VM ID.

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py; edit schema descriptions in Go. -->

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ibee_gpu_vm" "worker" {
  name             = "worker"
  site_id          = "SITE_ID"
  plan_id          = "PLAN_ID"
  template_id      = "TEMPLATE_ID"
  os_distro        = "ubuntu"
  os_type          = "linux"
  billing_interval = "HOURLY" # or MONTHLY (a one-month commitment); HOURLY when omitted
  ssh_key_ids      = ["SSH_KEY_ID"]

  # Required by the API to destroy a VM with an automatically assigned public IP.
  delete_public_ip_action = "release"
}
```

## Schema

| Attribute | Type | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `billing_interval` | `string` | Optional, Defaulted | Billing term: HOURLY (default for new VMs) or MONTHLY, a one-month commitment. Create copies the plan's billing_catalog and merges in the matching entry of its billing_options; the API checks the selection. Omitting it on an existing VM keeps the recorded term. No API operation changes the term, so changing it replaces the VM; the API refuses to delete or resize a committed VM (409 VM_COMMITTED) and deleting a VM does not cancel contractual charges. |
| `cpu` | `number` | Read-only |  |
| `delete_public_ip_action` | `string` | Optional | What to do with the VM's automatically assigned public IP on destroy: release or reserve. The API requires it for a VM with an automatically assigned public IP and refuses the destroy with 400 when it is missing; when unset the provider sends no public_ip_action and relays that answer. Reserving an address may continue billing. |
| `disk_gb` | `number` | Read-only |  |
| `gpu_count` | `number` | Read-only |  |
| `gpu_model` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `id` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `name` | `string` | Required | VM name. |
| `os_distro` | `string` | Required | Image OS distribution. |
| `os_type` | `string` | Required | Operating system family, such as linux or windows. |
| `plan_id` | `string` | Required | Plan from ibee_compute_plans. Create sends the plan's cpu, ram_mb and disk_gb. A change resizes the VM in place to the new plan's cpu, ram_mb and disk_gb through the resize operation; the API refuses changes it cannot make. |
| `private_ip` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `public_ip` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `ram_mb` | `number` | Read-only |  |
| `site_id` | `string` | Required | Placement site from ibee_sites. |
| `ssh_key_ids` | `set(string)` | Optional, Defaulted | Existing Secret Store SSH key IDs. Changes are applied in place through the VM access operation (keys are added before others are removed). |
| `status` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `tags` | `set(string)` | Optional, Defaulted | VM tags. Changes replace the VM because the public API has no tag update operation. |
| `template_id` | `string` | Required | Image template from ibee_images. |

## Import

Import an existing resource with the identifier shown. Review the imported plan before applying; creation-only settings and local deletion permissions cannot always be reconstructed from the API.

```shell
terraform import ibee_gpu_vm.worker 'VM_ID'
```
